text:
Liam (CEO): All-hands Thursday 9:30am PT in Main. 35 min. Please add one Q by Wed EOD. Recording will be posted.

Priya (VP Product): Quick agenda: 1) Exec update + hiring/priorities (Liam) 2) Launch callouts for region-aware routing (Priya/Marco) 3) Policy: EU data residency & audit logging (Nora) 4) Short incident recap + remedies (Elena) 5) 10-min open Q&A + 2 lightning demos.

Priya (VP Product): Preflight: reply with "demo" + 1-line blurb to request a 3-min slot. Upload slides to the folder by Wed 10pm PT. Link: https://redwood.internal/allhands/may-slate

Nora (CTO): Policy teaser: new EU data-residency shield and optional immutable audit logs for Private customers. Default hosted telemetry retention stays 90 days; opt-out paths documented. Full RFC on slide 7.

Elena (SRE): Incident note: Yesterday 02:4002:55 UTC a quota-misallocation in staging spilled synthetic traffic into a small set of prod routers, causing transient 429s for ~7 minutes for non-customer-facing probes. No customer data or real traffic affected. We'll cover root cause and guardrails.

Diego (Customer Success): Heads-up for CS: Marco and I will add a one-paragraph customer blurb for the support KB after the meeting. If you need a tailored statement for your accounts, DM me.

ops-bot: Reminder: add one question by Wed EOD to be eligible for live reading.

slides-bot: Please upload your 2 slides if requesting a demo slot. Deadline Wed 10pm PT.

(After meeting)

slides-bot: Recording & slides posted: https://redwood.internal/recordings/allhands-2519993337-2026-09-02.mp4 | https://redwood.internal/allhands/may-slate-final.pdf

Liam (CEO): Thanks all. Top takeaways: hiring focus on infra & CS, shipping region-aware routing next week, policy rollout for EU shield and audit logs, incident in staging fixed and guardrails added.

Priya (VP Product): Launch notes: region-aware routing will default-off for existing Dedicated customers; enabling steps and canary plan are in the slide deck. Eng leads: please publish exact timeline in #eng-releases by Fri.

Nora (CTO): Policy action: Security will publish the EU shield FAQ and the Private audit log opt-in form by Thu. Legal signed off on the wording.

Elena (SRE): Postmortem link is in #postmortems. Immediate fixes: tighten staging quotas, added synthetic-traffic isolation, new alert for cross-environment leak.

Diego (Customer Success): Customer-facing blurb approved: "No customer traffic or data impacted; we found and fixed a staging quota leak and added safeguards. We'll proactively notify customers with Dedicated onboarding scheduled next week."

Liam (CEO): Closing: if your Q wasn't read live, DM me or Priya and we'll answer on the record. Thanks for the crisp demos and questions. :tada:
